title: TELUS Digital Named as a Leader in Everest Group Customer Experience Management (CXM) Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment – Americas for the Eighth Consecutive Year
summary: TELUS Digital named a Leader in Everest Group's 2026 CXM Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment – Americas, for the eighth consecutive year.
body_markdown:
**Vancouver, B.C** . **(September 16, 2026)** -[TELUS Digital](https://www.telusdigital.com/) , a global technology service provider specializing in AI-powered digital customer experiences (CX) and future-focused digital transformations, has been named a Leader in the[Everest Group Customer Experience Management (CXM) Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026 – Americas](https://www.telusdigital.com/insights/customer-experience/resource/peak-matrix-cxm-2026) , for the eighth consecutive year. This is the analyst firm's highest ranking, highlighting TELUS Digital's capabilities across its proprietary artificial intelligence (AI) portfolio, global delivery network and diversified industry expertise. TELUS Digital was one of eight companies positioned as a Leader among the 48 CXM service providers assessed.


“TELUS Digital continues to strengthen its position as a Leader in Everest Group’s Customer Experience Management (CXM) Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026 – Americas, supported by its broad global delivery footprint, multilingual capabilities, diversified industry presence, and depth across core CXM services,” said Sharang Sharma, Vice President, Everest Group. “Its proprietary[Fuel iX™ suite](https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/fuel-ix) , spanning agent support, training, quality management, and enterprise AI orchestration, together with a broad technology partner ecosystem, enables TELUS Digital to support AI-enabled CX transformation across the customer lifecycle. Its flexible commercial models, including outcome-based constructs, along with strong client recognition for relationship management and delivery flexibility, further strengthen its proposition for enterprises.”


#### **TELUS Digital recognized for its capabilities across the CXM value chain**


The Everest Group CXM Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2026 – Americas pointed to TELUS Digital's capabilities in:


- Its Fuel iX platform for enterprise AI orchestration,[Fuel iX Agent Assist](https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/fuel-ix/agent-assist) for real-time agent support and[Fuel iX Agent Trainer](https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/fuel-ix/agent-trainer) for AI-led training and quality improvement.


- A broad technology partner network spanning Google Cloud, Zendesk, Five9, Amazon Connect, Cresta, ElevenLabs, Verint, Automation Anywhere and Sanas, extending its capabilities across CCaaS, analytics, automation, and conversational and agentic AI.


- A global delivery footprint supporting[50+ languages](https://www.telusdigital.com/about/locations) for clients based in the U.S., Canada, the U.K. and Ireland, Europe and Asia Pacific.


- Continued expansion in 2026 to strengthen multilingual[CX support in Southeast Asia](https://www.telusdigital.com/about/newsroom/telus-digital-expands-in-asia-and-argentina-to-meet-growing-demand-for-ai-and-cx-solutions) , along with the earlier acquisition of[Gerent](https://www.telusdigital.com/about/newsroom/telus-digital-expands-capabilities-with-addition-of-gerent) and the launch of an[AI research hub in Brazil](https://www.telusdigital.com/about/newsroom/telus-digital-ai-research-hub-unveiled-at-usp) , adding depth to its cloud, digital CX and agentic AI capabilities.


- Depth across customer service, technical support, sales services, compliance and security management, talent management, customer retention management, order fulfillment and transaction processing, and payment collections, serving clients across telecom, banking and financial services, media and entertainment, hi-tech, travel, transport and hospitality, software and platforms, energy and utilities, healthcare, consumer packaged goods (CPG), and insurance.


- Pricing maturity, with a mix of input, output, outcome and hybrid-based commercial models and notable depth in outcome-based constructs.


- Client feedback citing TELUS Digital's relationship management, flexibility and global delivery footprint, with particular appreciation for its multilingual capabilities and process-driven service delivery in key locations.


Everest Group also positioned TELUS Digital as a Major Contender in its CXM Services PEAK Matrix® Assessments 2026 for Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA) and Asia Pacific (APAC), citing its broad scope of CXM services, extensive industry coverage and pricing maturity across both regions, along with client feedback praising its relationship management, flexibility and multilingual delivery.


#### **TELUS Digital meets enterprise demand for accountable, production-ready AI**


Everest Group’s research indicates that as enterprises move from experimenting with generative AI tools toward integrated, production-scale AI operations, they are prioritizing customer experience providers who can take accountability across the full AI-enabled CX lifecycle, from strategy and journey design through implementation, workforce adoption and governance. Everest Group's analysis also shows that enterprises are weighing commercial models differently, favoring transparent, outcome-linked pricing over the lowest rate alone, and judging scale by a provider's ability to flex capacity across locations, channels, workforce models and AI-enabled delivery. Its research found that enterprises increasingly prioritize commercial flexibility and outcome accountability, and it points to TELUS Digital's mix of outcome-based models as meeting that demand.


“We’re seeing the market moving past the question of whether AI belongs in customer experience and into whether delivery partners can run it at scale and deliver measurable gains in resolution time, quality scores and customer satisfaction,” said Tobias Dengel, President, TELUS Digital. “That's the shift we've built our CXM delivery model around, pairing AI with the language, industry and operational depth enterprises need to move from pilots to production. Being named a Leader for the eighth consecutive year tells us our approach is working for our clients, and it's the bar we intend to keep exceeding for them.”


#### **Defining leadership in CXM services**


For its 2026 CXM Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment – Americas, Everest Group evaluated and ranked 48 CXM service providers as Leaders, Major Contenders or Aspirants, based on two dimensions: market impact, measured through market adoption, portfolio mix and value delivered; and vision and capability, measured through vision and strategy, scope of services offered, innovation and investments, and delivery footprint. The assessment draws on Everest Group's annual Request for Information (RFI) process for calendar year 2026, provider briefings, client reference checks, and its ongoing analysis of the CXM services market.
